definitions.anchored_rate_floor: official-anchored model and observed-bootstrap rate draws are clipped at zero by downstream validation/presentation consumers
definitions.conditional_independence: sign and magnitude draws are conditionally independent given features
definitions.crossing: error dollars equal abs(D) only when abs(D) is strictly greater than the fiscal-year threshold
definitions.physical_cap: abs(D) is winsorized at max(BENMAX, observed abs(D)) for each case-year before thresholding
definitions.prediction_scope: the shipped distributional model is frozen after FY2017-19 and FY2022; FY2023 fits state dollar factors and FY2024 validates the frozen configuration; no causal interpretation
definitions.state_factor: FY2023 out-of-sample empirical-Bayes scalar applied after the strict threshold to capped error dollars
definitions.tail: log-scale exponential excess beyond conditional q99, with scale fit as the weighted mean excess beyond q99 of OOF median residuals

dollar_rate_validation.factor_application: multiply physically capped, strictly thresholded per-case error dollars; the factor does not alter the latent signed D draw

level_ratio_gate.ratio: factor-adjusted analytic model / observed FY2024 sample

shrinkage.method: empirical-Bayes precision weighting around factor 1; observation variance uses a ratio influence function and the Kish effective sample size
shrinkage.prior_mean_choice: fixed at 1 so noisy states shrink toward no multiplicative adjustment rather than toward a data-estimated level

export.browser_consumer_status: browser scenario consumer live since 2026-08-07: app.js applies the SMD-only model_scenarios patch as its single policy lever, verifies the base-model sha256 pin before use, and disables the seven level-gated jurisdictions; the observed resample remains the no-scenario engine and the accounting-bound levers are removed
export.configuration: frozen-through-FY2022 distributional predictions, FY2023-fit dollar factors, per-case physical caps

coverage_signed_gap_pattern.interpretation: negative gaps are undercoverage: observed FY2024 magnitudes stochastically exceed the fitted quantiles

fy2024_weighted_pit.reference_note: The z score and scaled CvM use an iid Uniform(0,1) reference with Kish effective n. They are descriptive diagnostics, not design-based tests; they omit QC survey dependence and fitted-CDF uncertainty.

physical_cap.application: clip the final absolute D draw before the strict fiscal-year threshold; apply the state dollar factor after thresholding
physical_cap.derivation: BENMAX supplies the case's maximum-monthly-allotment-scale ceiling; taking the maximum with observed abs(D) preserves the realized support for records whose adjudicated deviation exceeds BENMAX

tail_fit.scale_se_method: empirical weighted mean-excess SE using Kish effective n; conditional on the estimated threshold and OOF predictions
tail_fit.threshold_stability_note: Training OOF mean excess declines through q97.5 and stabilizes at q99-q99.5. q99 matches the attachment depth while retaining more effective sample than q99.5. The FY2024 diagnostic q85 is bounded between the adjacent shipped q75 and q90 cutoffs, and q99.5 is bounded above q99, so the diagnostic thresholds remain ordered with the shipped grid; conditional excess is lower at both deepest cutoffs.

measured_rate_simulation.mc_error_method: standard error across independent seed-specific estimates: sample SD divided by sqrt(seed count)
measured_rate_simulation.model_process: read the serialized model_data arrays and scalar state factor; uniform CASE==1 row bootstrap; retain sampled HWGT in numerator and issuance denominator; redraw deviation occurrence and magnitude per sampled occurrence; cap |D|; apply the frozen state factor after the strict threshold; anchor each seed at its own model baseline mean
measured_rate_simulation.observed_process: uniform corrected-error row bootstrap retaining HWGT inside the ratio and centered at the official rate

oof_design.deployable_duan_smear: weighted mean exp(residual) over all full-training OOF residuals
oof_design.deployable_probability_calibrator: weighted isotonic fit on all full-training OOF base scores
oof_design.magnitude_training_metrics: outer-fold log predictions multiplied by Duan smears fit on inner OOF residuals from the corresponding outer training set
oof_design.probability_training_metrics: nested outer/inner cross-fitting; each outer calibrator is fit on inner OOF base scores from its outer training set

provenance.quantile_estimator: sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor with native quantile loss

tail.finite_variance_gate: point scale < 0.45 and scale + 1.96 * empirical weighted SE < 0.5
tail.method: weighted mean exponential excess on log-magnitude beyond q99 of OOF median residuals; attached above conditional q99

sign.export_note: p_pos is retained for sign analysis but omitted from model_data.json because measured error-rate outputs consume only abs(D)
